content: Ukutuna ekerenjo cha Yɨɨsu

Mmbe, kʉ kʉbha tʉna riribhita ikʉrʉ rya abhamɨnyɨɨkɨrɨri bhanʉ bhatwinaarirɨ, tʉtʉʉrɨ imirigʉ imiritʉ gɨnʉ rusizʉ, nʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhʉnʉ bhutwiruguurirɨ. Na tongʼehe kokora ganʉ Mungu atɨɨrɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwɨtʉ, chɨmbu ʉmʉʉtʉ akurya umwega kwa bhwigumirirya.

Tʉbhɨ tʉrarora Yɨɨsu, kʉ kʉbha newe ʉmʉtangɨ nu umuhichi wu ubhwisirirya bhwɨtʉ. Igʉrʉ wo obhozomerwa bhʉnʉ bhwarɨ embere waazɨ, atarʉʉzɨ sʉni, akiigumirirya uruku rwa kʉmʉsarabha. Ikɨɨrɨ ʉrʉbhaara rwu ubhuryʉ rwi ikitumbɨ chɨ ɨkɨtɨmi cha Mungu.
Mwiseege chɨmbu Yɨɨsu igumiriiryɨ ganʉ abhakʉri bhʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhaarɨ bhakumwanga, korereke mʉtaniha na kukwa umwʉyʉ.
Nangabha muriitana nʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ, nawe mʉkɨɨrɨ kwitana kuhika kwitɨra ɨkɨsaahɨ chanyu.
Nangʉ, mwɨbhirɨ amangʼana gʉ ʉkʉbhaha umwʉyʉ kurwa kwa Mungu ganʉ gakubhuga imwɨ nɨ‑bhaana bhaazɨ? Garabhuga,

content.text: “Mwana waanɨ, ʉtarega ganʉ Ʉmʉkʉrʉ Mungu akokotongera.
Na ahaatema umwana wʉwʉʉsi wʉnʉ akwisiriribhwa.”

content: Mwigumiriryɨ hanʉ Mungu akʉbhatongera. Arakorabhu kʉ kʉbha imwɨ nɨ‑bhaana bhaazɨ. Nɨ‑mwanakɨ wʉnʉ akɨɨrɨ kotongerwa na wiisɨ?
Mmbe mʉraatamɨ kotongerwa ncha abhaana abhandɨ, momenye imwɨ mʉtarɨ bhaana bhaazɨ, nawe nɨ‑bhaana bhi igʉtʉ.
Hamwɨmwɨ na gayo, bhabhaabha abhatwibhuri, bhaarɨ bharatotongera, na niitwɨ tʉkabhasʉʉka. Arɨɨbhɨ nɨmbu, tʉtakwenderwa kʉsʉʉka bhʉkʉngʼu Bhaabha wʉnʉ ari mwisaarʉ, korereke tʉbhɨ nʉ ʉbhʉhʉru?

Bhabhaabha abhatwibhuri, bhakatʉtɨnɨra kwibhaga isuuhubhu, chɨmbu ebho bhaarʉʉzɨ kʉbha nɨ‑bhwaheene. Nawe Mungu aratʉtɨnɨra igʉrʉ wu ubhwera bhwɨtʉ abheene, korereke tʉbhɨ hamwɨmwɨ nawe mʉbhʉrɨndu bhwazɨ.
Kotongerwa rɨtarɨ ingʼana rya kozomera, nawe rya kurumɨka bhʉkʉngʼu. Nawe ryahaahɨta ribhaga, bhanʉ bhiigiibhwɨ kʉhɨtɨra okotongerwa kuyo kʉbha ne eteemwa nzʉmu, bhariikara komorembe na kwe eheene.
Nangʉ mʉbhɨ na amanaga mʉmabhoko gaanyu amanyʉʉhɨrɨru na amaru gaanyu ganʉ gazɨgɨɨrɨ.
Mogende kʉnzɨra yɨnʉ ɨgʉrʉrʉkirɨ,
korereke kɨnʉ kɨrɨmɨɨrɨ kɨtaaza kʉnyahaarɨka, nawe kɨhʉnibhwɨ.
Amaangirijʉ kubhiisirirya
Mmbe, mʉkajɨ kwikara komorembe na abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi, kʉ kʉbha atareeho ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ akʉtʉra korora Ʉmʉkʉrʉ ataana ʉbhʉrɨndu bhuyo.
Mʉbhɨ mɨɨsʉ, korereke ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉwʉʉsi atarimirya ɨbhɨgʉngi bhya Mungu. Na ritina ryʉ ʉbhʉsʉngʉ rɨtaaza kʉsɨbhʉka gatɨ waanyu na kʉbhanyaacha, kʉhɨtɨra riyo abhaatʉ bhaaru bhakabhenga.
Mʉbhɨ mɨɨsʉ, korereke gatɨ waanyu atabhaho wɨ ɨtaarʉ, hamwɨ ʉmʉʉtʉ wʉnʉ atakʉsʉʉka Mungu ncha Ɨɨsau. Ewe akagurya eheene yu ubhwibhurwa bhwe embere igʉrʉ wu ukurya rʉmwɨbhu.
Mwɨzɨ ribhaga ɨrɨndɨ, hanʉ Ɨɨsau ɨɨndirɨ kʉgabha ʉrʉbhangʉ, wiisɨ akaanga. Ɨɨsau atabhwɨnɨ umweya gu ukutiga ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwazɨ, nangabha akagomohya kwa ngusuri.
Imwɨ mʉtaahikirɨ kʉkɨgʉrʉ kɨnʉ kɨkʉtʉra kugwatwaku cha Sinayi, kɨnʉ charɨ kikwaka omorero, kʉnʉ kwarɨ ni ikiirimya nʉ ʉmʉkama mʉhaari bhʉkʉngʼu.
Mʉtaahikirɨ hanʉ Abhiiziraɨri bhiigwirɨ rihembe rekotemwa na riraka ikʉrʉ rɨnʉ rɨkʉgamba. Hanʉ Abhiiziraɨri bhiigwirɨ riraka rirya, bhakʉʉbhaha bhʉkʉngʼu, bhakasabha Mungu atagambana nabhʉ kwikɨ.
Bhataaturirɨ kwigumirirya ubhuswaja bhʉnʉ Mungu aabhaswajiryɨ, “Nʉʉrʉ ni‑kityɨnyi kirikunʼyɨku kʉkɨgʉrʉ kuyo, kɨratemwa amabhwɨ.”
Gʉʉsi ganʉ gakʉriibhwɨ kʉkɨgʉrʉ cha Sinayi gakabhakanga bhʉkʉngʼu abhaatʉ, gakagirya Musa akabhuga, “Nɨrarigita bhʉkʉngʼu igʉrʉ wu ubhwʉbha.”
Nawe imwɨ muhikirɨ kʉkɨgʉrʉ cha Sayuuni, kʉrʉbhɨri rwa Mungu wʉ ʉbhʉhʉru, Yɨrusarɨɨmu ya mwisaarʉ. Mʉrʉbhɨri ruyo bhiibhiringirɨ bhamaraika ɨbhɨkwɨ nɨ ɨbhɨkwɨ kobhozomerwa.

Imwɨ muhikirɨ kukiikarʉ ɨkɨkʉrʉ cha abhiibhurwa bhe embere bha Mungu, bhanʉ amariina gaabhʉ gaandikirwɨ mwisaarʉ. Muhikirɨ mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa Mungu, umutiniri wa abhaatʉ bhʉʉsi, na mʉbhʉtangɨ bhwa zekoro za abhaatʉ bhe eheene bhanʉ Mungu abhakʉrirɨ bhanagu.
Imwɨ muhikirɨ kwa Yɨɨsu, umwigwanʼya wʉ ʉbhʉragɨ ubhuhya, na kʉmasaahɨ gaazɨ ganʉ giitikirɨ igʉrʉ wʉ ʉbhʉbhɨ bhwɨtʉ na kokora amangʼana amazʉmu kʉkɨra ga Abhɨɨri.

Mwangarɨrɨ mʉtaaza kwanga wʉnʉ akʉgambana na niimwɨ. Arɨɨbhɨ bhanʉ bhaangirɨ kumwitegeerera wʉnʉ abharɨchiryɨ, nangʉ tʉratʉrabhwɨ kongʼosa ɨtɨnɨrʉ arɨɨbhɨ tʉraanga kumwitegeerera Mungu hanʉ akotorecha?
Hanʉ Mungu aagambirɨ kurwa kʉkɨgʉrʉ cha Sinayi, ɨɨsɨ yʉʉsi ɨkarigita. Nawe nangʉ aragɨɨnʼyɨ, “Nɨrarigitya ɨɨsɨ kwikɨ. Na ɨtarɨ ɨɨsɨ iyeene, nɨrarigitya na risaarʉ.”
Ringʼana riyo “kwikɨ” rereerecha kʉbha, ebhegero bhyʉsi bhɨnʉ bhyatɨɨmirwɨ, bhɨrasingisa na kuruusibhwaho, korereke bhɨsaagɨ bhɨnʉ bhɨtakʉtʉra kusingiswa.
Mmbe, tukumyɨ Mungu, kʉ kʉbha tʉrabhona ʉbhʉtɨmi bhʉnʉ bhʉtakusingisa. Tʉbhɨ tʉramosengera kʉnzɨra yɨnʉ ekomozomera na kubhwikʉʉmu nu ubhusuuku,
kʉ kʉbha Mungu wɨɨtʉ ne‑morero mʉhaari gʉnʉ gukuricha.
